description: All images are actual screenshots, with original PNG retained. Labels describe intended actions, not assumed successes. Judge from actual visible results plus logged coordinates. A scenario label saying top-placed does not assert that stacking succeeded.

Clean offline browser context; no candidate JS evaluated by Node. Trusted immutable npm server is the same supplied to all candidates. Evaluation uses 3002 to avoid interfering with generation; generation self-check used 3000. Original generation browser-log is also retained. Warnings alone do not fail E03.
Clear first. Move without clicking, then click three distinct scene points and change color/size. Compare position/independence and whether original entities change.

Red bottom requested at an interior grid point, green requested on its visible top; repeat purple/green at a different point and inspect side angle. If model placement is displaced, judge that actual failure rather than assuming successful setup.

Create red/green 2x2 and purple 3x2; swap and place 2x3. Play, observe multiple timed frames over 5 seconds, attempt to pause using visible pause/play entry, then attempt editing and manual orbit. If Play cannot exit, subsequent programmatic size selection does not establish successful pause; use independent camera replay if supplied.

Use visible colored targets to hover/delete, change camera, delete current target, rebuild on remaining red. Some setup states may be unreachable because of candidate placement defects. Additional independent camera/erase or seed-top retarget evidence is supplied when needed; no candidate source state is used to prove behavior.
Open clear modal, click an exterior board point to check no clickthrough (dismissal is acceptable), then cancel; reopen and close via x; reopen and confirm; rebuild afterwards.

Early audit stopped at Python child-process permission; rerun intact from reload with original files retained. A screenshot pixel locator initially targeted a ghost because the requested red placement had moved to the bottom edge behind the toolbar; do not treat that mistaken top attempt alone as valid stacking evidence. The controlled S02-retarget-visible-seed sequence directly targets the actual red seed at (639,435) after reload and is the conclusive correction. Independent camera/erase checks restart after failed Play/pause to isolate those functions. Judge the screenshots independently.

SUP-independent-sequence shows the same three distinct requested positions after moving only the camera to reveal the placed entities. The original before/after images and action log are retained in supplement/.
